title: [2026-10-28-generative-atomic-poetry] 01 · Research: atomic units, context sensing, tap animations

plan.text: Answer the seven open questions (Markov/n-gram status; viewer vs. authored context; stroke reconstruction; scan crop vs. font; struck-through/inserted words as atoms; revised versions in blooms; participation tier)
Build the atom graph first: extend journal.json with stand-off units and scan regions; forced alignment below line level
Ship the permission-free variation tier (seed, time/season, touch, dwell, return visits) before opt-in sensors
Prototype concordance blooms from scan-crop sprite atlases
Enforce the Reserve at build time: atom extraction only over a published whitelist
Test on a real iPhone (motion permission, 60 fps cap, Low Power Mode)
